profile_bio.description: Founder @kargulstudio / We build products, websites, and brands.

tweets.text:
If you’re a designer trying to build a personal brand, here’s something most people get wrong.

They try to be known for everything.

UI, branding, motion, Web3, AI, no-code, all at once. That doesn’t build recall. It builds confusion.

When I started designing in 2016, I didn’t plan a personal brand.

I just kept doing one thing: branding.
Logos, identities, brand systems. Again and again.

Over time, people stopped asking if I could do branding.
They just came to me for it.

That single association made starting an agency easier than any marketing tactic.
People already trusted me before the first call.

If your goal is to build an agency one day, don’t chase range early.
Chase recall.

Pick the thing you want to be remembered for and earn that spot in people’s minds.

Most eCommerce founders have no idea how acquisitions actually work, and that’s why they never get bought.

For years, the M&A conversation in eCommerce has been full of noise: hype, fake multiples, and “experts” giving exit advice when they’ve never bought a single business.

Here’s the reality buyers actually care about in 2025:

- Clean financials
- Reliable cash flow
- Operational discipline
- Predictable customer acquisition

A beautiful brand doesn’t get you bought. A dependable machine does.

If you want optionality in this market, build something a buyer can trust, not something Instagram can admire.
